title: Chronos-Structure: Low-Threshold-Rank Decomposition for Exact Counting of Independent Sets on Bipartite Graphs
topic: The C-3PO Framework: Algorithms for #BIS-Hard Problems on Graphs with Low Threshold Rank
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Counting independent sets (\#BIS) is a canonical \#P-hard problem, yet many practical instances exhibit low threshold rank, enabling efficient exact algorithms. We introduce the Chronos-Structure, a Chronos-Interpreter framework that exploits the rank of the left-side adjacency matrix over GF(2) to decompose a bipartite graph into a tractable dynamic-programming subproblem. The framework implements Gaussian elimination for rank computation, a bit-vector representation for adjacency, and a recursive enumeration that runs in $O(2^{r} + |V|+|E|)$ time, where $r$ is the matrix rank. Formal invariants guarantee that the rank bound is preserved throughout the decomposition, and static analysis confirms the algorithm's structural complexity. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261102_050124_the_c-3po_framework__algorithm}.
